B02.visual_intent: A 12 x 6 pixel grid (outline cells). On 'for every pixel' a terracotta dot pops in every cell at once ('every pixel'). On 'built-ins', 'uniforms', 'textures' three labelled arrows slide in from the left, one per word. On 'remembers nothing' a grey sweep line crosses the grid and clears every cell ('remembers nothing'). On 'game state must arrive' a 'game code' box lands above, one rail with one tick into every column carries the mono word 'uniform', and every cell's dot comes back together.
B02.motion_claim: Every cell runs at once; the sweep wipes them (no memory); one line from game code reaches every cell.

show.event: dots pop in all 72 cells at once

B02.runner_up: Isometric conveyor (show-tell iso kit): built-ins, uniforms and textures riding belts into a GPU box
B02.why: The idea is parallelism plus no memory plus one shared value: a grid where every cell acts at once, is wiped, and then all receive the same line shows all three; a conveyor shows a queue, which is the opposite of 'all at once'.
